<entry id="T00104">
<head-word>רְבִיעִי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>fourth</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 29
<sup>b</sup> חל להיות … בר' (sub. בשבת) if the ninth of Ab falls … on a Wednesday; Meg. 22
<sup>b</sup>. Keth. I, 1 בתילה נשאת ליום הר' it is customary for a virgin to be married on the fourth day of the week; a. v. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>fourth grade of uncleanness</italic>. Ḥag. III, 2; Tosef. ib. III, 7 הר' פסול וכ' the fourth grade is a disqualification in sacrificial food, the third, in T’rumah. Ib. 18; a. fr.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. רְבִיעִית. Meg. III, 4 (29
<sup>a</sup>) בר' on the fourth Sabbath of Adar; a. fr.—Esp. (sub. לוֹג) 
<italic>one fourth of a Log</italic>. B. Bath. 58
<sup>b</sup> איזהו אנטל זהו ר' what is Anṭal? The fourth of a Log mentioned in connection with religious ceremonies (v. comment.). Y. Sabb. VIII, 11
<sup>a</sup> bot. ר' של תורה וכ' Ar. (ed. שיעורו של כוס) the legal 
<italic>r’biʿith</italic> (for the cup of the Passover night) is a bottom of two fingers by two, with a height of one and five-sixths of a finger. Sot. 5
<sup>a</sup> אדם שאין בו אלא ר' אחת וכ' man in whom there is only one-fourth of a Log (of vital blood, v. Rashi) &c.; Sabb. 31
<sup>b</sup> bot.; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. רְבִיעִיּוֹת</plural-form>. Sot. l. c. Lam. R. to IV, 1 (ref. to אבני קדש, ib.) אלו שתי ר' של דם וכ' this refers to the two-fourths of blood (of king Josiah) which Jeremiah took up (from the battlefield) and buried (v. II Chr. XXXV, 24 sq.). Pes. 112
<sup>a</sup> לילי ר' the nights of the fourth days of the week, Tuesday evenings; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00111">
<head-word>רִבִּית</head-word>
<head-word>רִי'</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (רָבַב = b. h. תַּרְבִּית) [
<italic>profit</italic>,] 
<italic>interest</italic> on a loan, 
<italic>usury</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 61
<sup>b</sup>, v. קָצַץ, a. אָבָק. Tosef. ib. IV, 3, v. הַעֲרָמָה. Ex. R. s. 31, a. fr. מלוה (ב)ר', v. לָוָה. Tosef. l. c. יש דברים שהן ר' ואינן ר' there are such transactions as have the appearance of usury, but are not usury (are not forbidden). B. Mets. 63
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. צד אחד בר' one-sided (eventual) usury, a transaction which may eventually result in paying interest on a loan, e.g. advanced payment for fruit to be delivered at some future time at present prices with the option, in case of a rise in the market, of returning the money and paying the difference, in which latter case it looks like paying interest on a loan; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. רִבִּיּוֹת, רִי'</plural-form>. Tosef. B. Mets. VI, 17 מלוי ר' כופרין וכ' those who lend on interest deny the essence &c. (v. עִיקָּר); (Y. ib. V, end, 10
<sup>d</sup> מלוה ברבית). Tosef. l. c. 18.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00114">
<head-word>רְבִיתָא</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (רְבֵי I) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>growth, that which advances growth, sanitary treatment</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 78
<sup>b</sup> רְבִיתֵיה דינוקא וכ' the proper treatment of a child consists in (bathing in) warm water and (rubbing with) oil. Ib. הנך דלאו רְבִיתַיְיהוּ (some ed. רְבִיתַיְהוּ) those things (as wearing shoes) which have nothing to do with their healthy growth; הנך דרביתייהו וכ' those other things (as ointing) which are needed for their health &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>growth, spontaneous healing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 46
<sup>b</sup> bot. היינו רביתייהו this position of the adhering lungs (one overlapping the other) is the means of healing; v., however, next w.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> = רְבוּתָא 
<italic>something great, remarkable</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Keth. V, beg. 29
<sup>c</sup> אשכח גידול ר' ומר וכ' G. found something great and reported something small.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00120">
<head-word>רַבָּן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v.

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>chief, teacher</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. תינוקות של בית ר' school children.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>Rabban</italic>, a title of scholars.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Eduy. III, 4 [read.] מי שיש לו תלמידים ותלמידי תלמידיו קוראין אותו רבי נשתכחו תלמידיו קוראין אותו ר' וכ' if a scholar has disciples and disciples of his disciples, he is quoted (by the latter) as Rabbi; if his direct disciples are forgotten (in tradition), he is quoted as Rabban; if both are forgotten, he is quoted by his name.—Esp. 
<italic>Rabban</italic>, title of most of the presidents of Palestinian colleges that succeeded Hillel. Ab. I, 16. Ib. 18. Ib. II, 8; a. fr. (v., respective proper names).—
<plural-form>Pl. רַבָּנִים, רַבָּנִין</plural-form>. Cant. R. to I, 10 נאוו … אלו הר' וכ' ‘comely are thy cheeks’ &c. (ib.), this refers to the teachers, ‘thy neck with strings’, refers to the students &c. (v. חָרַז); Yalk. ib. 983; a. e.—[Gen. R. s. 61 כמין שני רבנים, v. כַּד II.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00121">

<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>chief; teacher</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Chr. XI, 11. Ib. 21 (h. text שר). Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 15 רבנהון Ms. (ed. רבהון); a. e.—Y. Ter. VIII, 46
<sup>a</sup> זמון חד ר' וכ' invited a certain teacher and placed a dog beside him. Y. B. Mets. II, end, 8
<sup>d</sup> חד ר' דמך וכ' a certain scholar is dead, and all the people are running &c.; a. e.—Esp. 
<italic>Rabbana</italic>, a Babylonian title. Keth. 22
<sup>a</sup> ר' אשי. Yeb. 22
<sup>a</sup> מר בריה דר' Mar, the son of R. (Ashshi). Pes. 115
<sup>b</sup> ר' עוקבא; a. e.; [perh. = רַבֵּנוּ 
<italic>our teacher</italic>].—
<plural-form>Pl. רַבָּנִין, רַבָּנָן</plural-form>. Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 28 (h. text שרי); a. e.—Y. Ter. VIII, 45
<sup>c</sup>; Y. Maasr. V, 52
<sup>a</sup> top, a. e. חברון דר', v. הֲנַנְיָא. Succ. 8
<sup>a</sup>; Erub. 76
<sup>b</sup> ר' דקיסרי the scholars of Cæsaræa; a. fr.—Esp. (corresp. to חכמים of the Mishnah, v. חָכָם) 
<italic>a number of scholars</italic>, as opposed to a single authority. Pes. 10
<sup>a</sup>. Erub. 23
<sup>a</sup>. Ber. 5
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.—דְּרַ', מִדְּרַ' 
<italic>rabbinical enactment, rabbinically ordained</italic>, opp. דאוריתא, מדאורייתא, v. אוֹרָיָיא. Succ. 44
<sup>a</sup>. Pes. l. c.; a. v. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. I כשני רבנן, v. כַּד II.—Y. Kidd. I, 61
<sup>b</sup> bot. דרבנין, v. רוּבָּה II.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00128">
<head-word>רָבַע</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to lie with, copulate with, cover</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40
<sup>a</sup> top והלא מביא … והוא רוֹבְעָהּ וכ' but may he not bring (the crippled sire) to her, and he cover her, and she may give birth? Ib. והיא רוֹבַעַת ממנו וכ' and she (the crippled mare) may be fecundated by him.—Esp. 
<italic>a</italic>) (with ref. to Lev. XX, 16) 
<italic>to have connection with a beast</italic>. Snh. I, 4 הרוֹבֵעַ והנִרְבָּע the animal that covered (a woman), and the animal that was covered (by a man). B. Kam. 40
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>to commit pederasty</italic>. Snh. 9
<sup>b</sup> פלוני רְבָעוֹ לאונסו וכ' (if a man says) such and such a man committed sodomy with him (euphem. for 
<italic>me</italic>) against his will, he himself in connection with another witness can testify &c.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to fructify the ground</italic>. Taan. 6
<sup>b</sup> דבר שרובע, v. רְבִיעָה.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִרְבַּע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be covered</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to be copulated in an unnatural way</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. I, 4, v. supra. Ab. Zar. 24
<sup>a</sup> וולד הנִרְבַּעַת אסורה the issue of a beast that was used for buggery while pregnant is disqualified for the altar; היא וולדה נִירְבְּעוּ for mother and child have been abused; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>רִבֵּעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (v. (v. רְבִיעָה) 
<italic>to inundate</italic> for the sake of improving the soil.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah VII, 20
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to המרבץ, ib. V, 19
<sup>a</sup> top) מביון שהוא מְרַבְּעָהּ וכ' because he inundates it, it will yield so much more next year.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of אַרְבַּע) 
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>to do for the fourth time</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 306 הוי מפטם … ומְרַבֵּע perfume (thyself) with the words of the Law, and do it a second, a third, and a fourth time; Yalk. ib. 942.—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>to quadrate, make quadrilateral</italic>. Part. pass. מְרוּבָּע; f. מְרוּבַּעַת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְרוּבָּעִים, מְרוּבָּעִין; מְרוּבָּעוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Maasr. V, end, 52

<number>—2)</number>

<sup>b</sup> אולי יַרְגִּישׁ המקום וכ' (Esther, in inviting Haman, thought,) perhaps God will feel (compassion at my self-humiliation), and do a miracle for us. Sabb. 13
<sup>b</sup> אין בשר המת מרגיש באיזמל dead flesh feels not the knife (we have grown indolent through the frequency of persecutions); אין … שבחי מרגיש וכ' the dead flesh in a living body feels not &c.; Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>d</sup> bot. Y. Ber. V, 9

<sup>b</sup> שאילו ישמט הוא מרגיש if it should slip off, he would find it out. Gen. R. s. 47 ה' ונצטער he felt (the pain of circumcision) and suffered. Pesik. R. s. 11 כל הפירות … מַרְגִּישִׁים … וכילם … ומרגישים of all fruits in a bag, you take some, and the others are not affected, but in the case of nuts … all are in heavy commotion; כך ישראל … וכילם מרגישים so is it with Israel: one man sins, and all feel the effect of it; Yalk. <sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to run: to pursue</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 44 רָדַפְתִּי מלכים וכ' I pursued the kings to Damascus. Ab. Zar. 75
<sup>a</sup> שמימיו רוֹדְפִין (Ms. M. רדופין), v. infra. Snh. VIII, 7 הרוֹדֵף אחר חבירו וכ' he that runs after his fellowman with murderous intention. Ib. 74
<sup>a</sup> רודף שהיה רודף אחר רודף וכ' a pursuer who runs after a pursuer in order to save him (prevent him from murder); a. fr.—Pes. 114
<sup>a</sup> אכול בצל … ולבך רודף עליך Ms. M. 1 (ed. ויהא לבך וכ', Ms. M. 2 רדוף) eat onion and sit in the shade (v. צֵל), rather than eat goose and chicken with thy heart within thee running (being restless and greedy).—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. רָדוּף; f. רְדוּפָה &c. 
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>quick, rapid</italic>. Ab. Zar. 75
<sup>a</sup> מעיין שמימיו רְדוּפִין Ms. M. (ed. רודפין) a spring whose waters run rapidly; (Y. ib. V, end, 45
<sup>b</sup> נהר שמימיו מהלכין).—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>anxious, longing</italic>. Tosef. Yeb. VI, 6 הרי שהיתה ר' לילך וכ' if the wife (at the time of her husband’s death) has been following her desire to go on a visit to her parental home; Yeb. 42
<sup>b</sup>. Keth. 71
<sup>b</sup> כאן בר' וכ' in the one case it means when she is anxious to go home (during her first year of married life) &c. Ib. ככלה … ור' לילך וכ' like a bride that has been found perfect in her husband’s paternal home, and is anxious to go home and tell &c.; Pes. 87
<sup>a</sup>.—רגל (ה)רְדוּפִין 
<italic>the first festival after marriage</italic>. Y. ib. VIII, 35
<sup>d</sup> top איזהו רגל הר' … שאביה רוֹדְפָהּ וכ' which festival is ‘the festival of the anxious’?… The first festival after marriage, when her father urges her to go back to her husband’s house. Ib. לא הלכה … רגל ר' if she did not go home for the first festival, may the second festival be considered ‘the festival of the anxious’ (with regard to her partaking of the father’s Passover meal)? Cant. R. to VIII, 9 בת מלכים … ר' ר' a princess that went to observe the first festival at her father’s house; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
